title: Text: DET Jim Leyland ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Tell Gene to call or text me ...734-752-9667 -Anthony
Good, just watching this football game. What’s new with you?
Not much a little cold in Detroit?
There’s light at the end of the tunnel. It was brutal, didn’t leave my house for a few days. Lakeland in about a month - the best part of the job
Thought about you earlier, talking with someone about Hosmer. A lot of writers think he is “overrated” ...I think they’re crazy. He’s a great player, one of the best 1B
Ok... that’s why I bring it up. I will call you this week to talk Baseball. Later.
